auth: keyless public endpoint (per-IP pool: 1,000/h, 10 rps; https://docs.keenable.ai/rate-limits)
method: open-loop fixed-rate arrivals, 60s per stage, ramp 0.5 -> 1 -> 1.5 -> 2 rps, hard cap 2 rps; 12-query rotating fintech workload (pro, realtime, point-in-time)
client: Mac, residential ISP; latency = wall time incl. TLS + body read (not server time)
caveat: Keyless pool is shared per IP and capped at 10 rps; this test probes our client-side tail at <=2 rps, not Keenable's production capacity (100+ RPS Frontier is a contracted tier).
